eval.description: OpenAI internal dynamic multi-turn safety evals where an adversarial user simulator continues the conversation based on model replies. Categories are mental health, emotional reliance, and self-harm. Unlike static multi-turn evals that score only the final reply, these score whether any assistant turn violates policy (not_unsafe / safe completion). Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model stays safe across a whole conversation when a simulated user pushes on self-harm topics.

versions.changes: OpenAI reports these dynamic adversarial simulations were introduced ahead of GPT-5.3 Instant and first tabulated in the GPT-5.4 Thinking card. Policies, graders, and simulators may evolve.

scores.description: An assistant turn in the dynamic conversation does not violate the relevant OpenAI policy.

metrics.description: Share of assistant messages scored not_unsafe across the dynamic conversation (also reported as safe). Higher is better. Per category.
